notes: All amounts converted from Rs million (as reported) to Rs crore (/10), 4 dp. EPU, DPU in Rs per unit. Sign convention as disclosed (deductions/outflows negative in NDCF).

Primary source = NSE results filing for the quarter (first column). Because most filings are scanned with OCR text layers, each value was cross-checked against the same period shown as a comparative in later filings (previous-quarter and prior-year-quarter columns); the majority value was used and arithmetic checks (TI, TE, PBT, tax, PAT, owners+NCI, NDCF A/B/C, NDCF line sums) were run on every quarter.

1QFY22 is the period 13-May-2021 (acquisition of the 5 initial SPVs) to 30-Jun-2021; PGInvIT did not file separate Q1/Q2 FY22 results (only H1FY22). 1QFY22 and 2QFY22 P&L come from the comparative columns of the Q1FY23 and Q2FY23 filings (they sum to the H1FY22 half-year results).

2QFY22 NDCF lines (Trust and SPV, old framework) are derived as H1FY22 (Nov-2021 filing) minus 1QFY22 (Q1FY23 filing comparative) where the Q2FY23 comparative column was missing or OCR-garbled (52 line items; flagged in sources as derived). The Q2FY23 comparative Trust NDCF (4,095.77 mn) equals H1 4,096.21 less Q1 0.44.

First distribution Rs 4.50/unit (Rs 3.02 interest, 0.96 taxable dividend, 0.52 exempt dividend; record date 15-Nov-2021) covers 13-May to 30-Sep-2021 and is placed in 2QFY22; 1QFY22 has no separate distribution (null).

NDCF framework: SEBI revised NDCF framework (circular dated 15-May-2024) used by PGInvIT from 1QFY25. Old-framework lines (trust.old_framework.*, spv.*.old_framework.*) cover 1QFY22-4QFY24; new-framework lines (*.new_framework.*) cover 1QFY25-1QFY27. No old-framework statement exists for 1QFY25.

The Q4FY24 results filing (NSE 22-May-2024) is an image-only scan with no text layer; 4QFY24 P&L taken from Q1FY25 and Q4FY25 filing comparatives (identical), 4QFY24 old-framework NDCF from the earlier-framework annexure of the Q4FY25 filing (quarter ended 31-Mar-2024 column); DPU from the Q4FY24 cover letter.

Q1FY27 (Results_Q1_FY27_Jun2026.pdf, same file as NSE PGINVIT_28072026144237_OUTCOMEBM.pdf) is a scan with garbled text: P&L checked against page images (pp.5, 13); all Q1FY27 NDCF lines transcribed from page images (pp.7, 16-20). Q1FY27 filing comparatives were excluded from reconciliation of earlier quarters.

Restated comparatives: 3QFY25 Trust NDCF was 2,723.30 mn as originally filed (capex/loan to SPV -6.82, retained -6.70) but shown as 2,717.02 mn (capex -13.10, retained -12.98) in the Q3FY26 filing; original used (ties to FY25 audited NDCF 10,810.15). 4QFY25 VTL retained/distributed 45.05/503.47 originally vs 45.45/503.07 in the Q4FY26 comparative; original used.

Manual overrides of OCR-garbled values (verified by arithmetic within the statement): standalone 4QFY24 impairment reversal -355.40, 4QFY26 other expenses 2.11/trustee nil; consolidated 4QFY23 other expenses 134.53, 4QFY24 owners 2,523.02, 4QFY26 other income 85.92; NDCF 2QFY23 WTL 800.08, 4QFY23 VTL PAT 162.51, 1QFY24 VTL other adj -38.24, 3QFY24 PPTL 781.52, 2QFY25 Trust CFO -35.66, 4QFY25 Trust CFO/SPV receipts/capex -137.26/3,218.87/-10.32, 3QFY25 WTL capex -6.30, 4QFY25 WTL capex -5.48, 1QFY25 JPTL distributed 627.15, 4QFY26 PPTL distributed 786.24 (all Rs mn).

Standalone income split (interest on loans to SPVs vs dividend from SPVs) is from the related-party transaction notes in each filing (accrual basis, sums to revenue within 0.01 mn rounding). 2QFY22 = H1FY22 less 1QFY22; 2QFY25 interest = 9MFY25 less 1QFY25 and 3QFY25; 1QFY27 interest = revenue less dividend 599.91.

Legal/professional fees are not reported as a separate line in PGInvIT results (inside other expenses): null. Statutory audit fee is booked in Q4 (and occasionally other quarters). Standalone has no depreciation, employee, O&M or project manager lines.
Consolidated EBITDA is derived (not reported): total income (or revenue) less total expenses excluding finance costs, depreciation and impairment/(reversal).

Impairment lines: standalone = impairment/(reversal) of investment in subsidiaries; consolidated = impairment/(reversal) of goodwill, PPE and intangibles. Large items: 2QFY22 (H1), 2QFY23 (cons 1,309.73 cr), 4QFY25 standalone reversal 1,095.90 cr.

Units outstanding 909,999,200 throughout (allotted 13-May-2021, no further issuance). distribution_amount_dpu_x_units_derived = DPU x units; ndcf_distributed_disclosed is the Trust "NDCF distributed to unitholders" line (new framework only). Old framework has no distributed line; Trust NDCF vs DPU x units differences are listed under checks.ndcf_internal.
NSE files are referenced by attachment name; local copies in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Power/562dd684-59fa-5b19-94f2-822ecbb92d34/scratchpad/agentB/pdfs/. Page numbers are PDF page numbers.
